aggregation: sqrt(longcat_ratio * hy_worldplay_8b_ratio); workload_ratio = sum over the workload's cases of bf16_kv_bytes / sum of stored_kv_bytes

final.rounds: host-side standalone final, trusted oracle and control replays through scripts/eval_archive.sh
final.run_gate_policy: calibrated release; per-workload mean gates and every per-case floor and wall gate pass

interactive.rounds: agent-initiated manual submissions only (cooldown 300 s); the same hidden suite as the final

sharding.devices: 1-8 identical devices visible to the Judge; every device stays visible and each case binds its own by index
sharding.per_device: one candidate UID and one CPU slice per device; cases run one after another: isolated generation, then fidelity and VBench on the same device
sharding.score_dependence: none: the device count changes only the wall time
